Admin.heading: Administration
Admin.remboursementsIntro: Transactions refunded on FanBoss's side but not yet actually refunded via CinetPay (see CLAUDE.md “Automatic CinetPay refunds”). Once the refund has been done manually in the CinetPay dashboard, mark it as processed here.
Admin.verificationIntro: Tier 1 (free): the créateur adds the displayed code to their bio, an admin confirms visually. Tier 2: a conflict (same display name as someone else) requires third-party identity verification (KYC) -- no automated integration exists yet, see CLAUDE.md.
Admin.publicationsSignaleesIntro: Hide removes the publication everywhere (profile and Home feed) and closes the report. Reject closes the report without touching the publication.
Admin.topCreateursHeading: Top 10 créateurs by volume -- this month
Admin.topDonateursIntro: Always complete, regardless of each person's public supporter badge opt-in.

verifications.kycNotice: This case requires identity verification by a third-party provider (KYC) -- no badge should be granted to either conflicting account until this is resolved manually.

Admin.litigesIntro: Videos/shoutouts the fan flagged as a problem (see CLAUDE.md “Fan confirmation state”). Money isn't refunded automatically -- these cases need a manual review.

Admin.retraitsIntro: A créateur's withdrawal requests against their wallet balance (minimum $25). “Mark handled” means a real manual transfer has already been made outside the app -- there is still no automated payout in this project.
